name: CLB v7.0.9 Turntable Playback Sync Repair
notes: Repairs Spotify-to-turntable synchronization: keeps the official IFrame controller instead of inventing a soft-ready state, starts the motor responsively on an accepted deck command, reconciles it with authoritative playback events, keeps spinning through buffering, and preserves rotation under system reduced-motion unless the site motion control is explicitly Off.
